ETFC.description: Ambient Temperature Function (ETFC). TYPE selects which fields apply: CONST uses TEMP, SINE uses MAX_TEMP/MEAN_TEMP/DELAY_TIME, and USER uses SCALE_FACTOR plus the ITEM time-value function data.

TYPE.description: Ambient temperature function type (case-insensitive). CONST: constant temperature. SINE: sinusoidal variation. USER: user-defined time-value function.

MAX_TEMP.description: [TYPE=SINE] Maximum temperature (T) of the sine function.

MEAN_TEMP.description: [TYPE=SINE] Mean temperature (To) of the sine function.

DELAY_TIME.description: [TYPE=SINE] Delay time (to) of the sine function.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: [TYPE=USER] Scale factor applied to the user-defined function data.

ITEM.description: [TYPE=USER] User-defined function data as an array of time-value points. Required and must be non-empty when TYPE is USER.

VALUE.description: Temperature value at the given time.
